passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: Amy is my classmate, and she is a kind girl.
phrases.ko: 에이미는 나의 반 친구이고, 친절한 여자아이예요.
phrases.zh: 艾米是我的同学，她是个善良的女孩。
phrases.py: ài mǐ shì wǒ de tóng xué， tā shì gè shàn liáng de nǚ hái。

phrases.en: I sit next to her in class.
phrases.ko: 나는 수업 시간에 에이미 옆에 앉아요.
phrases.py: shàng kè shí wǒ zuò zài tā páng biān。

phrases.en: She is quiet, but she smiles at me.
phrases.zh: 她很安静，可是会对我笑。
phrases.py: tā hěn ān jìng， kě shì huì duì wǒ xiào。

phrases.en: She can lend a pencil when I forget mine.
phrases.ko: 내가 연필을 잊어버리면 에이미가 빌려 줄 수 있어요.
phrases.zh: 我忘了带铅笔，她可以借给我。
phrases.py: wǒ wàng le dài qiān bǐ， tā kě yǐ jiè gěi wǒ。
wǔ fàn hòu wǒ men yì qǐ xué xí。

phrases.en: I like my classmate because she is fair.
phrases.ko: 에이미는 공정해서 나는 반 친구를 좋아해요.
phrases.zh: 我喜欢我的同学，因为她很公平。
phrases.py: wǒ xǐ huān wǒ de tóng xué， yīn wèi tā hěn gōng píng。

phrases.en: We are both in the sixth grade.
phrases.py: wǒ men dōu shàng liù nián jí。

phrases.en: She sits next to the window.
phrases.py: tā zuò zài chuāng hù páng biān。

phrases.en: A quiet classmate can still be a good friend.
phrases.ko: 조용한 반 친구도 좋은 친구가 될 수 있어요.
phrases.zh: 安静的同学也可以是好朋友。
phrases.py: ān jìng de tóng xué yě kě yǐ shì hǎo péng yǒu。
wǒ men yì qǐ xué yīng yǔ。

phrases.en: I am happy she can lend me a pencil.
phrases.ko: 연필을 빌려 줄 수 있어서 기뻐요.
phrases.zh: 她能借给我铅笔，我很高兴。
phrases.py: tā néng jiè gěi wǒ qiān bǐ， wǒ hěn gāo xìng。

full_passage_spoken: Amy is my classmate, and she is a kind girl. I sit next to her in class. She is quiet, but she smiles at me. She can lend a pencil when I forget mine. We study together after lunch. I like my classmate because she is fair. We are both in the sixth grade. She sits next to the window. A quiet classmate can still be a good friend. We study English together. I am happy she can lend me a pencil.
full_passage_zh: 艾米是我的同学，她是个善良的女孩。上课时我坐在她旁边。她很安静，可是会对我笑。我忘了带铅笔，她可以借给我。午饭后我们一起学习。我喜欢我的同学，因为她很公平。我们都上六年级。她坐在窗户旁边。安静的同学也可以是好朋友。我们一起学英语。她能借给我铅笔，我很高兴。
